execution.database: Temporary disposable PostgreSQL database created and removed by the isolated test runner
execution.listenerIdentity: Two distinct PostgreSQL LISTEN backend PIDs observed for the independent API processes

verified: Day-state updates cross from API process A to an SSE peer on process B.
Delivery is isolated by watched date and live versus sandbox scope.
Duplicate notifications do not duplicate peer updates.
A terminated listener reconnects; when the missing event is pruned, the peer receives a canonical gap reconciliation.
A durable event inserted without NOTIFY is delivered by cursor polling.
Reset, rollover, and master-data invalidations reach the intended live peers.
A fresh SSE connection on process B receives the current canonical snapshot.
Core /api/readyz remains healthy when the optional peer listener is deliberately stopped.
Graceful API child-process shutdown closes its LISTEN connection; no listener backends remain after both children exit.
